description: Empirical COP-vs-deltaT lookup for a Bi2Te3 Peltier cooler (ZT~0.7) with hot side fixed at 300 K. COP_max = Tc/(Th-Tc) * (sqrt(1+ZT)-Th/Tc)/(sqrt(1+ZT)+1).

ZT.note: Figure of merit Z*T_mean for Bi2Te3 (reused from EC217 F1a)

Th_ref.note: Hot-side reference temperature for the lookup table

alpha_Seebeck.note: Seebeck coefficient per couple (reused from F1a)

lookup.note: Breakpoints: temperature lift deltaT=Th-Tc (K) -> coefficient of performance (max-COP operating point), Th=300K

COP.note: Rated COP ~0.75 at 30K lift for ZT=0.7 Bi2Te3
